subject: Marketing pixels & DPIA checklist / privacy policy updates
messages:
From: AdSquare Legal <privacy@adsquare.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.company>
Date: 2026-03-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial DPIA question about marketing pixels on Redwood public site

Hi Marissa,

We’re running a quick vendor intake for Brightside and AdSquare—both are evaluating placing marketing pixels via CMP placements on Redwood’s marketing site. Our compliance team flagged a potential DPIA because the combination of unique device identifiers + ad profile stitching could be considered high-risk processing under Art. 35.

Could you confirm the following:
- Which pixels are currently active on https://www.redwood.com (names + vendor domains)
- Whether any pixel sends hashed email or user IDs to third parties
- Whether you rely on consent or legitimate interest for these pixels in the EU

I’ve attached our suggested inventory template to speed this up. If you have an internal DPIA or a cookie inventory export, that would be perfect.

Attachments: pixel_inventory.csv, gdpr_dpia_template.docx

Thanks,
Olav Pettersen
AdSquare Legal
privacy@adsquare.co

---
Note: this is an external vendor request.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.company>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.company>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.company>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPIA question about marketing pixels on Redwood public site

Hi Olav — thanks for the heads up and the template. Looping in Sergio (Product security) and Laura (Legal) to confirm details.

High level response first: we do not send raw email addresses to ad vendors. We do occasionally transmit hashed IDs (SHA256) for a small set of consented customers for ad re-targeting; that is logged and limited. Our EU-facing site uses consent by default for marketing/ad pixels; we do not rely on legitimate interest for advertising at scale.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Sergio will pull the current cookie/pixel inventory from the GTM container and fill your attached template. (ETA EOD 3/3)
- Laura will confirm whether the hashed-ID flow has a documented DPIA or if we should run a short DPIA scoped to marketing pixels.
- I’ll send a sample cookie-consent snippet we use for the EU banner.

Can we schedule a 30-min sync on Wed (3/4) to run through any outstanding questions?

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.company | +1 415-555-0187

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.company>

Date: 2026-03-03T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial DPIA question about marketing pixels on Redwood public site

Marissa / Laura — I exported the GTM container and ran the vendor list. Quick notes:
- Active third-party pixels: Google Ads (google.com), DoubleClick (doubleclick.net), LinkedIn (licdn.com), Hotjar (hotjar.com), Brightside tracking (brightside-marketing.com).
- Items that transmit hashed IDs: our re-targeting pipeline sends SHA256 hashed email+salt to Google and Brightside only when the user has opted into marketing during signup or via an explicit banner consent. We do not salt client-side; salting happens server-side prior to upload.
- Retention: ad match lists kept for 90 days; analytics cookies 13 months (we keep a short telemetry cookie for product blogs at 13 months).

I dropped the GTM export and a filled CSV snapshot into the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_pixel_docs

My recommendation:
1) Run a focused DPIA scoped to re-targeting + hashed-ID uploads (should be a 1–2 page assessment).
2) Update the privacy policy section on third-party advertising references to explicitly call out hashed-ID uploads and retention.
3) Provide vendors with the DPA/SCC references — we already have SCCs in place via our cloud providers; will attach the DPA reference doc.

Attachments: [GTM_export.json (in Drive), pixel_inventory.csv (in Drive snapshot)]

Sergio
Product Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks — that’s really helpful.

We’d like to confirm the following items ahead of our sync:
- Can you share the exact consent banner copy currently shown to EU visitors? We need to ensure our scripts only fire after consent is recorded.
- A redacted example of the hashed-ID payload (header names, hashed value length) so our security team can validate we’re not receiving PII.
- Confirmation you have SCCs in place with Brightside (we’ll need the DPA contact + a standard SCC appendix).

We’re available Wed 3/4 at 10:00am PT — confirmed for the 30-min sync. I’ll invite our privacy engineer as well.

Best,
Jane
Brightside Marketing
